captured_note: Ported from the capture's self-contained methods/32_nepa: its ViT step 1 (models/nepa_vit.py, data/datasets.py, train_pretrain_model.py, evaluate_linear.py) and its unified ViT-B/16 Step 2 (configs/step2_vit.yaml, train_step2_vit.py -- the same models/nepa_vit.py at patch_size 16). These are the lab's own implementation of Xu et al. (2025) NEPA. NEPA ships its OWN Vision Transformer (models/nepa_vit.py -- measured: it imports only torch, NOT timm, despite timm appearing as a floor in the capture's requirements.txt) and trains from scratch on ImageNet-1k, so this ports self-contained and torch-only. The port keeps the capture directory numbering (32) per the 2026-08-09 keep-capture-numbering decision (this list's number 37 is NEPA -- see docs/PORTING_ROADMAP.md).
scope: The ViT step 1 is ported: patch embeddings z = f(x) (a Conv2d patch embed, optional CLS token) are run through a causal autoregressive predictor h (a stack of transformer blocks with 2D RoPE, QK-norm, LayerScale and GeLU/optional-SwiGLU MLPs, causal attention) to give z_hat; the loss is the negative cosine similarity between z_hat[:, :-1] and a stop-gradient shifted target z[:, 1:] (SimSiam style). An EMA copy of the whole model is kept (decay 0.9999) and is what evaluation uses. AdamW under a cosine LR schedule with warmup; the peak LR is base_lr * global_batch / 256; gradient-norm clipping. The capture's unified ViT-B/16 Step 2 is also ported additively -- the SAME NEPAModel at the unified setting (patch_size 16, step2 augmentation, SwiGLU, the unified AdamW recipe) with milestone checkpoints, selected by configs/pretrain_vit.yaml (save_at_epochs); the native ViT-B/14 step-1 config is unchanged. The Step-2 linear probe pools raw patch embeddings (pool: embed, the capture's step2 choice) rather than the native AR-output average.
encoder: encoder.pt is the EMA model (ema_model.*, the prefix stripped so it loads straight into a plain NEPAModel): the patch embed, the (optional) CLS token, the causal transformer blocks and the final norm -- the whole model, since NEPA's representation is the autoregressive predictor output, not a separable backbone. The online model (the gradient-trained copy) is training machinery and is excluded. The EMA model (not the online model) is shipped -- it is the representation NEPA is evaluated on (the capture's own eval uses the EMA model by default).
linear_eval: Reads the trained encoder.pt and probes the EMA model's avg-pooled causal autoregressive output (extract_features pool='avg'; embed_dim), a genuine learned representation, so the number is comparable. Images use the deterministic val pipeline (resize + centre crop, NEPA's 0.5/0.5 normalisation -- the same normalisation NEPA trains with). The capture's own eval trains an AdamW linear head; this port follows the lab's shared ARSSL probe (mean-centre + L2-normalise features, single linear layer, SGD momentum + cosine, top1/top5) rather than the capture's own head, so the number is comparable across the ported methods.
rewritten_during_the_port: the native ViT step 1 and the capture's unified ViT-B/16 Step 2 are both ported; the Step 2 is the same NEPAModel at the unified setting (patch_size 16 vs step-1 14, step2 augmentation, SwiGLU, unified AdamW recipe) plus milestone checkpoints (save_at_epochs [100,200,300]), selected by configs/pretrain_vit.yaml. save_at_epochs is an optional pretrain key (absent = native step 1, unchanged); the data loader gained a step2 augmentation (RandomResizedCrop + flip + ColorJitter); the eval gained an optional pool key (default avg; the Step-2 config sets pool: embed, the capture's step2 raw-patch-embedding probe). configs/linear_eval_vit.yaml is added. No new dependency (NEPA is torch-only; no timm).

NEPA's own nepa_vit.py is ported (torch-only, no timm -- the timm floor in the capture's requirements.txt is never imported, measured); a build_nepa_model constructing from explicit dims is added alongside the capture's build_nepa_vit_base/_large so a small hermetic CPU smoke can run a tiny ViT (head_dim divisible by 4 for the 2D RoPE)
the 2D RoPE, QK-norm, LayerScale, GeLU/SwiGLU blocks, the causal autoregressive predictor, the stop-gradient negative-cosine loss and the EMA update are kept faithfully (all torch)
the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA (the capture called .cuda())
main() split into build_parser()/run(args, config) returning the pretext loss and epoch count
the run is seeded through make_deterministic (python, numpy, torch); the DataLoader gets a seeded generator

the training loop drops the upstream DistributedDataParallel, the bf16 autocast and TensorBoard/tqdm so the same step runs on a CPU or a GPU unchanged, single-process fp32; the cosine LR schedule with warmup and the batch-linear peak-LR scaling are kept
